prompt: ONE new standalone square 1024x1024 pure artwork for PORCELAIN UMBRA, an invented world of hand-pierced eggshell-thin ivory bisque porcelain shadow theatres. Gallery craft photograph at oblique overhead angle. Entire compact sculpture centrally isolated within 20 percent fully transparent empty margins, no floor, no opaque backdrop, no pedestal. Real alpha transparency. Crisp readable thumbnail shapes. Absolutely no text, numbers, logos, UI, dates, clocks, dials, clock hands, batteries, living animals or ordinary objects. Only one sculpture, no variants or contact sheet, no border.
